paper_claim.benchmark_text_says_trials: Mean of at least three trials for each method on each dataset

metric_contract.auc: Average-rank AUC from the label-1 probability
metric_contract.acc: Accuracy from label-1 probability greater than 0.5

repository_finding.finding: The training script assigned best_model to the live model object, so later optimisation could change the object intended to preserve the best validation epoch.
repository_finding.fix: The later revision changed both assignments to deepcopy(model).
repository_finding.unresolved: The released prediction files do not identify their generating code revision, so this review cannot establish whether the defect affected them.

claim_boundary: We re-evaluated three author-released test prediction files against the official test labels. We did not retrain the model, reproduce the whole paper, establish patient-independent splitting, or perform clinical validation of a diagnostic system.
